name: Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes Are Not Contained in Cube-Chordal Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes belongs to Cube-Chordal Ample Classes.
proof: The product of two three-direction paths is median and hence peripheral, while the product criterion excludes cube chordality.
